intro: One plate of nasi minyak with a little dalca and acar is about 600 kcal. Most calories come from the rice itself, cooked with ghee, milk and santan.

variants.name: Full kenduri nasi minyak set (chicken, beef, acar, dalca)

diet: Yes. We usually see nasi minyak at kenduri, so it's not a daily food anyway. Nasi minyak on its own is already high in calories but low in protein. The real issue is adding two or three dishes and going for a second plate. Have one plate with one protein dish, and enjoy it without guilt.
tips: Take a bit less rice and pick just one protein dish, like chicken.
Add acar timun or salad to feel fuller.
At kenduri, eat slowly and skip the second plate. Have fruit or plain water after.

swap.name: 1 cup nasi minyak + skinless ayam masak merah + acar timun
swap.why: Smaller rice portion and more protein, so you feel fuller for about the same calories.

faq.q: Why is nasi minyak always at weddings?
faq.a: Nasi minyak is seen as a special dish because it's fragrant and rich. It became a tradition for weddings and big kenduri.

faq.q: What oil is used in nasi minyak?
faq.a: Usually minyak sapi or ghee, with spices like star anise, cinnamon and cardamom. Some recipes add evaporated milk or santan.

faq.q: Can I cook a lighter nasi minyak at home?
faq.a: Yes. Cut the ghee by half and use low-fat milk. It still smells great if you use enough spices.
